# 样例：vLLM /metrics 片段（来自官方文档风格，用于解析测试）
# HELP vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc Fraction of GPU KV cache used.
# TYPE vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc gauge
vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc 0.64
# HELP vllm:num_requests_running Number of requests currently running
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_running gauge
vllm:num_requests_running 8
# HELP vllm:num_requests_waiting Number of requests waiting to be processed
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_waiting gauge
vllm:num_requests_waiting 3
# HELP vllm:num_preemptions_total Cumulative number of preemptions
# TYPE vllm:num_preemptions_total counter
vllm:num_preemptions_total 17
# HELP vllm:request_success_total Cumulative number of successful requests
# TYPE vllm:request_success_total counter
vllm:request_success_total 120
# HELP vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds Time to first token in seconds
# TYPE vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds summary
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds{quantile="0.5"} 0.35
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds{quantile="0.99"} 1.9
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count 1
vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum 1
